about.h: Pavel Korchagin: I see tasks through to results
about.p1: I’m 31 and from Bryansk, Russia. I work with Figma, Tilda, Salebot and GetCourse and hold certificates in HTML, CSS and JavaScript — so where a site builder hits its limits, I write the code myself.
about.p2: I love complex, unconventional tasks: getting to the bottom of a problem, finding the best solution and seeing it through to a working result. I keep learning new tools so your project is built on a current stack.
tr1.d: I own the whole result, not just my piece
tr2.d: We agree on deadlines up front, and I keep them
tr3.d: No panic, even with urgent tasks
tr4.d: I test everything on every device before handoff

faq.h: Answers to the questions I hear most
faq.ai.d: Didn’t find your answer? My AI assistant knows everything about services, timelines and prices and will reply right now — any time of day.
q1.q: How much does a turnkey project cost?
q1.a: It depends on scope: a business-card site, a complex animated Zero Block and a GetCourse school are priced differently. Current prices for every service are on the services page, where you can also estimate the cost of your task.
q2.q: How long does a website, bot or school take?
q2.a: A business-card site takes from 5–7 business days, a complex animated Zero Block from 2–3 weeks. A “website + bot + school” package is scoped individually after the brief.
q3.q: Can I order just one stage instead of a turnkey project?
q3.a: Yes. You can order only design, only development, only a bot or only GetCourse setup — I work on single tasks as well as the full cycle.
q4.q: Do you work with existing websites or only from scratch?
q4.a: Both: I improve existing Tilda sites, add animations and bots — or build everything from scratch, whichever suits you.
